quote: A vehicle shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.

activation.condition: A vehicle stands unattended upon a perceptible grade on a highway.

obligation.description: Stop engine, effectively set brake and turn front wheels toward curb or highway side.

timing.description: Observed standing interval and responsible-person attendance transition.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Responsible-person actions cannot be inferred from a vacant seat.
Parking-brake engagement and held-vehicle motion require independent readings.
